[[{{C|Strength}}]] 你的力量决定了你造成的近战伤害（通过提高 你的护甲穿透力），你抵抗强制移动的能力，以及你的 承载能力。
[[{{C|Agility}}]] 你的敏捷决定了你近战和远程的准确性和你躲避攻击的能力。
[[{{C|Toughness}}]] 你的体质决定了你的生命值，你的生命再生速度，以及你抵抗毒物和疾病的能力。
[[{{C|Intelligence}}]] 你的智力决定了你的技能点数和检查遗物的能力。
[[{{C|Willpower}}]] 你的意志力会调整你激活的技能的冷却时间，决定你抵抗精神攻击的能力，并修改你的命中 点再生率。
[[{{C|Ego}}]] 你的自我决定了你的心理突变的效力，与商人讨价还价的能力，以及你支配意志的能力其他生物的。
[[{{C|护甲值和闪避值 (AV / DV)}}]] 你的护甲值 (AV) 衡量的是你受到的保护程度，抵御对你的物理攻击。AV越高，对手对你造成伤害越低，大多数人物的AV初始值都是0。
你的闪避值 (DV) 衡量的是你被物理攻击击中的可能性。DV越高，对手击中你的可能性越低。DV 由你的敏捷修正值修改。 人物初始DV最大是6.
[[{{C|精神护甲 (MA)}}]] 精神护甲（MA）是衡量你抵御精神攻击能力（包括混乱、精神分裂和灵能武器）的指标，就像你的护甲值衡量你抵御物理攻击的能力一样。 MA越高，敌人的心灵攻击对你造成严重影响的可能性就越小。MA会受到意志力修正值的影响。大多数角色的基础MA为4。
[[{{C|速度 (QN)}}]] 你的速度值衡量你执行每一个动作的速度。你的基础敏捷值为100。请注意，增强这个值的方法非常少。
[[{{C|移动速度 (MS)}}]] 你的移动速度衡量你行走或飞行的速度。你的基础移动速度为100。
[[{{C|温度 (T)}}]] 你的温度衡量你有多热或多冷。如果你感到寒冷，你的敏捷值会减半。如果你被冻结，你将无法进行物理动作。 如果你着火了，你会在每回合受到热伤害，直到你的温度降低。
[[{{C|耐酸}}]] 你的酸性抗性衡量你抵御酸性伤害的能力。你的基础酸性抗性值为0。当达到100时，你对酸性伤害免疫。
[[{{C|耐寒}}]] 你的寒冷抗性衡量你抵御寒冷伤害的能力，以及你对降低温度效果的隔离程度。你的基础寒冷抗性值为0。 当达到100时，你对寒冷伤害免疫，并且温度无法被降低
[[{{C|耐电}}]] 你的电抗性衡量你抵御电击伤害的能力，以及你对电流的抗性。你的基础电抗性值为0。当达到100时，你对电击伤害免疫，并且不导电。
[[{{C|耐热}}]] 你的热抗性衡量你抵御热伤害的能力，以及你对增加温度效果的隔离程度。你的基础热抗性值为0。 当达到100时，你对热伤害免疫，并且温度无法被提升。

Your skills represent the abilities you have learned in your life. Each skill tree has several skills associated with it. You begin with several skills determined by your caste or calling. You may purchase other skills by spending skill points which you earn when you gain a level (the higher your intelligence score, the more skill points you earn).
To purchase a new skill, you must first purchase the entry skill in its skill tree. You must meet any attribute or power requirements of the skill you are trying to purchase. It is possible to begin with certain skills without having its entry skill if your caste or calling has granted it to you.
Skills often grant you activated abilities. Once you purchase a skill, you may access your new activated ability from the Manage Abilities menu ('~CmdAbilities').

Mutations are special biological powers gifted to the denizens of Qud -- true kin from the outer arcologies do not possess mutations. There are two types of mutations: physical and mental. Each mutation has a mutation score associated with it. The scores of your physical mutations and the cooldowns of activated abilities granted by your physical mutations are static. On the other hand, the scores of your mental mutations are modified by your Ego modifier and the cooldowns of abilities granted by your mental mutations are modulated by 5% for each point of Willpower you possess above or below 16.
Most characters begin with mutation scores of 1. You earn a mutation point when you gain a new level which you may spend to augment the score of one of your mutations by 1. The mutation score of none of your mutations may exceed 1 plus your character level divided by 2. Additionally, mutations may only be augmented by mutation points up to a maximum score of 10, though your mental mutations may exceed this score if your Ego further augments them beyond 10.
Alternatively, you may spend 4 mutation points to choose a new mutation from three randomly selected mutations. The mutation you choose begins with a score of 1. If you are a chimera, you are offered a choice of physical mutations, if you are an esper, you are offered mental mutations, otherwise you are offered three completely random mutations. Mutations often grant you activated abilities. Once you gain a mutation, you may access your new activated ability from the Manage Abilities menu ('~CmdAbilities').
Defects are mutations with primarily negative effects. Certain mutants begin with a single defect. There is no score associated with defects.
遗物是技术复杂到古德的居民中少有人理解的物品。 一个未识别的遗物会被你显示为‘奇异遗物’。你可以检查一个遗物以尝试识别它。 如果成功，你将缩小该遗物功能的可能性（例如，曾经是‘棍棒’，现在你可以识别为‘步枪’）。最终你可以完全识别该遗物。 然而，每次你尝试识别物品而失败时，都有小概率会损坏它。成功识别遗物的机会取决于你的智力值。

药剂是化学配方的混合物，可以以多种方式提升你的精神和身体属性。 它们是遗物，因此你必须成功识别它们才能了解它们的作用。 在服用一种药剂的同时再服用另一种药剂是危险的；每当你服用新的药剂时，药剂之间不良反应的可能性会增加。 你的耐力值越高，你能在不产生不良效果的情况下服用多种药剂的机会就越大。
药剂对真人的影响比对变异人的效果更强。此外，由于变异者的体内化学成分本质上不稳定，变异者服用药剂时 有5%的机会会产生不良效果。
药剂可以通过工匠技能调制。除了需要一些零件外，调制药剂通常还需要一种自然材料。

[[{{C|Weapons}}]] Every weapon has a penetration value and a damage value (for example, {{C|}}4, {{R|}}1d4). The penetration value of melee weapons is related to your strength score, though the value is capped based on the material of the weapon ('l'ook at a weapon to view its penetration cap). Missile weapons have static penetration values that do not change based on your strength score. Weapons may modify other statistics; 'l'ook at a weapon to fully determine what it does.
[[{{C|Armor}}]] Most pieces of armor have an armor value and a dodge value (for example, {{b|}}4 {{K| }}4)) that augment your own {{b|}}AV and {{K| }}DV (see {{g|Attributes}}). Pieces of armor may modify other statistics; 'l'ook at a piece of armor to fully determine what it does.

[[{{C|Melee Combat}}]] Melee combat is combat between two adjacent opponents with standard melee weapons such as swords, daggers, axes, and clubs. To attack a hostile adjacent opponent, simply move in the direction of the opponent. To attack something else, such as a non-hostile opponent or a wall, use '~CmdAttackDirection' and select the direction in which you wish to attack.
When you make a melee attack against a target, the following sequence of events occurs:
[[{{c|1. Determine whether or not you hit the target.}}]] Your to-hit roll is 1d20 plus your agility modifier plus any bonuses you receive from your weapon or skill powers. If this roll exceeds your opponent's dodge value (DV), then you hit. An empty circle icon over your target indicates that your attack missed.
[[{{c|2. Determine whether a shield block takes place.}}]] If the target has a shield equipped, they have a base 25% chance to block with it, increasing with skill. A successful block adds the shield's armor value (AV) to the target's AV for this attack.
[[{{c|3. Determine how severely your attack penetrates your target's armor.}}]] Each weapon has a penetration value ({{C|}}4, for example). This value represents the armor value (AV) that your weapon will usually penetrate with ease. If your weapon's penetration value far exceeds your target's AV, your weapon will likely penetrate several times. Each time your weapon penetrates your target's armor, your target is dealt damage equal to your weapon's damage value ({{R|}}1d4, for example). A filled circle icon over your target indicates that your attack hit but failed to penetrate your target's armor. A heart icon indicates that your attack hit and penetrated your target's armor.
[[{{c|4. Determine if multiple attacks are made.}}]] There is a 15% chance that you make an additional attack with your secondary hand. Characters with multiple limbs may make additional attacks beyond this.
[[{{C|Missile Combat}}]] Missile combat is combat between two opponents with missile weapons such as bows, pistols, and rifles. To make a missile attack, press '~CmdFire' to aim your weapon, then '~CmdFire' again to fire.
When you make a missile attack, the following sequence of events occurs:
[[{{c|1. Determine the trajectory of your missile.}}]] How far a missile is likely to veer from its projected path is determined by your agility score and the weapon's accuracy.
[[{{c|2. Hit the first medium-sized or larger object along the missile's}} {{c|trajectory.}}]]
[[{{c|3. Determine how severely the missile penetrates your target's armor.}}]] This is resolved in the same way as a melee attack.
[[{{c|4. Determine if multiple attacks are made.}}]] Certain powers allow you to fire multiple missiles with certain missile weapons.
If you are engaged in melee combat with more than one hostile opponent, there is a 50% chance that each missile attack you make goes wild (veers 45 degrees to the left or right).
某些效果或能力要求生物进行豁免检定或面临后果。 每个豁免检定都有一个属性和难度值。要通过豁免检定，你需要掷一个基础的1d20，然后 加上相关属性的修正值。如果这个数字达到或超过了难度值，则通过检定； 否则，检定失败。一些针对生物能力的豁免检定也会将生物的属性修正值加入到难度值中。

完成某项任务所需的时间是以行动成本来衡量的。大多数任务的行动成本为1000。 你的QN提高了你恢复这一成本的速度，使你能够比较慢的生物更频繁地行动。
一些技能、变异和装备使你能够以减少或零行动成本执行特定的行动。
